pages.quiz:
WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

4. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

5. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.

7. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.

8. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

11. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

12. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

2. B — Information and Communication Technology

3. D — CPU

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

9. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Trends in woodwork; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Portable Power Tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Woodworking Machines; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
